notes: Maine resolved 346 of 437 placer keys (79%), under the 95% bar, and it is a source limit rather than a collection miss. The 2025 championship ran as one combined Class A/B event (Flo 12842725) that prints no grades at all, and the 2024 girls event prints none either, so a placer whose only podium is in those two slices has no grade anywhere. Resolution came from Flo prints where they exist, 35 school-form propagations across the 2025 event's different school strings, 24 RankWrestlers dated records and 9 New England payload prints. Same disclosure as Rhode Island and Vermont (31 Oct 2026).

Class C is not on Flo in any year, across five search phrasings. Recorded as 'not on Flo', never as 'does not exist': if the MPA runs a Class C championship, Maine's coverage has a documented hole at it rather than a complete picture (31 Oct 2026).

The 2024 'MPA Maine States' and All-States New England Qualifier meets are not in this build. They are a possible extra layer, the same shape as New Hampshire's Meet of Champions, and are Matt's call rather than an omission (31 Oct 2026).

Two girls' weights wrestled as two-wrestler pools with no placement match, so their places are derived by the micro-bracket rule - one wrestler won every meeting: 2024 165 Zady Paige 1st over Tori Mosher, and 2025 235 Lillian Soper 1st over Lucianna Pike. That 2024 pool paired the same two girls repeatedly under one round name, which is why the bout importer now separates repeated pool meetings by the source's own bout number (31 Oct 2026).

Kylan Berry won the Class A title at 106 in 2024 and 113 in 2025 for Marshwood and at 113 in 2026 for Bonny Eagle - one wrestler, class of 2027, who transferred. The 2026 Bonny Eagle row carries no year of its own and is attached to his profile on that evidence: three consecutive titles, a coherent 106-113-113 weight progression and a New England entry in each of the three years under the same school progression. The New England payload separately prints him 'HS Senior' in both 2025 and 2026, which cannot be true in either year alongside the 2027 class, so the year itself stays as Maine's own prints have it and the contradiction is noted rather than resolved by a script (31 Oct 2026).

Two 2025 champions have no class year and so no profile, named here rather than left in a count. Joe Lathwood (Biddeford/Thornton, 165) has no dated record anywhere checked; a younger Lathwood wrestles at the same school in 2026, also undated. Connor Pease (Camden Hills, 144) has one lead that is NOT applied: the NHSCA divisions file lists a 'Conor Pease' from Maine in the 2023 Sophomore division at 138, which would make him the class of 2025 and a senior champion. The spelling differs by a letter and the NHSCA row carries no school, but the same file lists Landon Pease of Camden Hills one weight below him in that very event, whose own class of 2025 is confirmed by Maine's prints. It is left as a lead because the consequence either way is the same - a 2025 graduate gets no profile - and a one-letter name match should not be written down as a fact (31 Oct 2026).
